mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 6-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional regime conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 6 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 4.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a contraction in the housing sector amid monetary tightening, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to the combined effect on consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of persistent inflation above 3.5% (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% for 3 consecutive months), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL has exceeded 3.5% for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) relative to its 6-month moving average indicates robust consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS has increased over the prior 6 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has fallen below 100.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown in both the labor market and housing sector, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to the combined effect on consumer confidence and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and HOUST declines, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a labor market recovery (UNRATE declining for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as employment gains boost consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has declined for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
